home.title: ComplyStart — Compliance Programs for Government & Supplier Requirements
home.description: Get a documented compliance program — code of conduct, policies, whistleblower channel, training — built in minutes. For companies in Argentina, Brazil, and Mexico.

home.hero: Your customer or government buyer wants proof of a compliance program. Here it is.
home.sub: Code of conduct, policies, a whistleblower channel, and employee training — generated, branded, and ready in minutes. No lawyer. No consultant. No waiting.
home.why: Two things force small and mid-sized companies to prove they have a compliance program: bidding on a government contract, and selling to a large multinational customer who audits its suppliers. Neither cares how big you are. Both want documentation.
home.item1: A code of conduct with your company's name on it, grounded in the law that applies to you.
home.item2: Written policies covering bribery, gifts, conflicts of interest, and dealing with public officials.
home.item3: A branded whistleblower reporting line — your employees and partners can report concerns confidentially.
home.item4: Short employee training, with proof everyone completed it.
home.item5: A record of every employee who's read and accepted your policies.
home.item6: A quick screening tool for checking your vendors against sanctions lists.
home.item7: One PDF binder that packages all of the above — hand it to whoever's asking.
home.availability: Full legal-citation support for Argentina, Brazil, and Mexico. Don't see your country?

landing.metaTitle: Compliance Program for Companies — Law 27.401 | ComplyStart
landing.metaDescription: Set up your integrity program in minutes: code of conduct, policies, whistleblower channel and training. Ready for public tenders or audits by multinational customers.
landing.hero: Are you being asked for an integrity program to bid for government contracts or to supply a multinational? You can have it ready in minutes.
landing.sub: Code of conduct, policies, your own whistleblower channel and training for your team. No law firm, no consultants, no waiting.
landing.why: Law 27.401 on Corporate Criminal Liability is not mandatory for every company — but in practice it is if you contract with the national government. And more and more multinational customers (US, Europe) require their local suppliers to have a documented program, even where Argentine law does not ask for it.
landing.min: To contract with the national government, Law 27.401 requires: a code of conduct, specific policies to prevent offenses in dealings with the public administration, and periodic training. It also recommends — and international buyers usually require — risk analysis, a whistleblower channel, an internal investigations protocol and the appointment of a compliance officer.
landing.minNote: This is general information, not legal advice.
landing.pricingCta: One price, everything included. No fine print.

faq.a1: No. It gives you the baseline documentation most buyers and agencies ask for. For specific or high-risk situations, we recommend legal advice.
faq.q2: Does it work for any public agency?
faq.a2: The content is built on Law 27.401. Some agencies may have additional requirements of their own in the tender documents — always review the bidding terms.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: The program is generated instantly after payment. Inviting employees and having them complete the training depends on your team.
faq.q2: Can I edit the code of conduct and the policies?
faq.a2: Yes, you can regenerate them with adjustments from your dashboard.
faq.a3: By default, yes. Reporters can choose to leave their contact details if they prefer.
faq.q4: What happens if I change my employee plan?
faq.a4: You can add or remove employees at any time from the dashboard.
faq.q5: Does this certify that my company complies with the law?
faq.a5: No. It gives you the documentation most buyers and agencies ask for. It is not a legal certificate and does not replace professional advice for your specific case.
